data.reason: The fifth review returned two findings. F1, high: render_cost sorts the per-model rows by cost_cents, which the previous attempt made None for a row nothing could price, so report --sprint raises TypeError on this ticket's own delivered figures and writes no report at all; the fix for the fourth review's F3 caused it and every test of the section renders only priced rows. F2: the plan position a proved slice is keyed by is optional and its absence silently skips the route comparison, and require_template_fields never recurses into a slice object, so criterion 3's refusal can be avoided by leaving a field out rather than by running on the routed model.
